title: Int8 Absmax Quantization
hints: Each row gets its own scale: max(|W[i]|) / 127. An all-zero row would divide by zero, so give it scale 1.
np.round rounds halves to even (2.5 -> 2). You need halves away from zero: sign(x) * floor(|x| + 0.5).
Cast q to int8 only after rounding and clipping. Dequantize with q.astype(float) * scale[:, None].
